questions: How many oxidized or etched CsV3Sb5 devices did you make, and how many showed a field-free diode? The pristine and Ti-doped counts are given (Table S1, Figs. S13, S14).
Were any treated CsV3Sb5 devices set aside, and why?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: total sweeps per condition, the field values in Fig. 4, and were any pristine devices measured at 0.1 to 0.2 T out of plane?
What does the second-best dataset look like, for example the other two stage-two sweeps of Device 11 beside the 83.61% sweep in Fig. 2c?

How was zero field set and checked after the field sweeps of Fig. 4 and the 1 T field cooling of Figs. S8 and S9, and how was the tilt calibrated for the in-plane fields of Fig. S10? Hou et al. (https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.09276) see a diode below 1 Oe and a false in-plane diode from a 0.01 degree tilt, which at 0.3 T is about 0.5 Oe out of plane.
What threshold defines the onset current, given the 10 μA ac excitation in Fig. S3 and critical currents of 17 to 36 μA in Fig. S4, and does η keep its sign if Ic is read at another dV/dI feature?
How do Ti-doped Devices 15 and 16 compare with Devices 11 to 14 in thickness, Tc, critical current and etched geometry, and does Device 16 show a diode at 0.1 to 0.2 T?

Which devices do Figs. S3 and S4 show? Fig. S3 is captioned "Device 12 (Fig. 2 in the main text)" (Supp. p. 6), though Fig. 2 shows Device 11; Fig. S4 is "Device 13 after successive oxidation stages" (Supp. p. 7), though p. 5 gives its η range to Device 12; and Supp. p. 2 lists "30.86% for sweep #5" where Fig. S4e reads η = -30.86%.
